title: Porphyrias: Biochemical Patterns and Clinical Clues

quickRevision: Acute intermittent porphyria can cause recurrent abdominal pain, autonomic symptoms and neuropathy without a characteristic photosensitive rash.

sections.title: Core biomedical mechanism
points: Acute intermittent porphyria can cause recurrent abdominal pain, autonomic symptoms and neuropathy without a characteristic photosensitive rash.
Porphyria cutanea tarda is associated with cutaneous photosensitivity and blistering on sun-exposed skin.
